name: Bodh Gaya

fields.nearest_hospital: Anugrah Narayan Magadh Medical College & Hospital (ANMMCH)

notes: Hospital ANMMCH listed at https://gaya.nic.in/public-utility-category/hospitals/ — Sherghati Road, Gaya, listed phone 0531-2410339 (the printed STD code is wrong on the gov page — Gaya STD is 0631 — left phone out of payload to avoid life-safety risk). Distance 14 km Bodh Gaya→Gaya is the medical-college teaching hospital, the closest govt tertiary ER. ANMMCH is a govt medical college so ER assumed true. Bodh Gaya station-level number not on https://gaya.nic.in/police/ (only SSP Gaya 9031826204 and SP-City 9031826205 published) — left null rather than fabricate. e-Samadhaan helpline 9304401000 is grievance redressal, not emergency. DM Collectorate 0631-2222900 acts as rescue/coordination per https://gaya.nic.in/contact-directory/. Pharmacy/mechanic/tow not on any .nic.in page → null.
